market.title: Wet Market
market.subtitle: Morning prices. Grade A keeps longer and tastes better.

service.title: Service
service.mistake: Tired hands — you fumbled the bowl!

shop.title: {{brand}} Shop
shop.previewBanner: PREVIEW — NOTHING IS FOR SALE YET
shop.previewOrder: Preview build: orders are not real and never leave the device.
shop.smallPrint: This is a preview of a future shop. No prices, no payments, no personal data — just noodle dreams.

instant_spicy.name: Instant Phở — Sweat Edition
instant_spicy.desc: For people who think regret is a flavour.

bowl_set.name: Street Cart Bowl Set
bowl_set.desc: Two bowls, two spoons, zero excuses for sad desk lunches.

street_cap.name: Pho King Cap
street_cap.desc: Tell the world exactly how your noodles are doing.

card_deck.name: Character Card Deck
card_deck.desc: All your street friends and enemies, printed at 63×88.

empire.title: {{brand}} Global
empire.subtitle: Instant noodles. Worldwide. From one street cart.
empire.prestige: Retire & start a new legend (+{{bonus}}% forever)
empire.prestigeConfirm: Hand the empire to family and start again with a permanent bonus?

gang_shakedown.title: A Visit From The Boys
gang_shakedown.body: Minh 'The Hammer' leans on your cart, casually crushing a lime. 'Nice spot. Be a shame if the queue got... rearranged.'

c.negotiate: Offer his ma a free bowl every morning
c.resist: Stand your ground — Minh's got your back

r.pay: He pockets the note and straightens your stool 'for free'.
r.negotiate: He goes quiet. 'She likes extra herbs.' You have a deal — and maybe a friend.
r.resist: Minh waves the boys off. 'This one feeds Ma. Walk on.'

old_debt.title: Your Father's Tab
old_debt.body: A ledger from years back surfaces: your father owed the district crew. Minh slides it across the counter without a word.

c.ask_minh: Ask Minh to make it disappear

r.pay: Minh nods slowly. 'Respect.' Word of it travels the street.
r.refuse: He shrugs and leaves. The lime on your counter is crushed flat.
r.ask_minh: He burns the page over your stove. 'We're even now. Don't ask twice.'

gang_party.title: Karaoke Catering
gang_party.body: Sáu 'Silk' wants forty bowls delivered to her karaoke bar by nine. Tonight. Hot.

c.cater: Fire up the pots — money's money

r.cater: Forty bowls, zero spills, one standing ovation between power ballads.
r.decline: 'Pity,' she says, in a tone that costs you nothing. Yet.

rent_hike.title: The Rent Goes Up
rent_hike.body: Mr Phúc appears the same afternoon your new sign goes up. 'Inflation,' he sighs, eyeing the queue.

c.haggle: Point at the leaking roof and haggle
c.kim: Mention Madam Kim is offering you her shophouse

r.pay: He counts it twice and blesses your doorway on the way out.
r.haggle: He settles for half, muttering about 'sentimental landlords'.
r.kim: His face does arithmetic. The rent stays where it was.

eviction_threat.title: Papers On The Door
eviction_threat.body: An eviction notice, taped crooked. Mr Phúc claims a 'better tenant' made an offer.

c.deposit: Match it with a year's deposit (1.000.000 ₫)
c.chin: Let Auntie Chín have a quiet word

r.deposit: Money talks. The notice comes down before the tape dries.
r.plead: He gives you a month, loudly, so the whole street hears.
r.chin: Whatever she said, he now waves at you twice a day.

employee_theft.title: Short Till
employee_theft.body: The till is light again. Lan won't meet your eye over the dish rack.

c.confront: Confront her in front of everyone
c.forgive: Cover it and ask her quietly what's wrong
c.police: Have Officer Long ask the questions

r.confront: She owns up — her mother's medicine. The kitchen goes very quiet.
r.forgive: Her mother's medicine. She pays you back in double shifts and loyalty.
r.police: Long recovers most of it. Lan's dreams of her own stall move elsewhere.

no_show_rush.title: No-Show at Noon
no_show_rush.body: Tuấn's moto died across town and the lunch queue is bending around the corner.

c.push: Work the line alone like a machine
c.close: Cap the queue and close early
c.family: Ring little Thu to skip homework club

r.push: You serve them all. Your arms file a formal complaint.
r.close: The uncles at the back do not take it gracefully.
r.family: Thu runs trays like a pro and invoices you in ice cream.

chef_walkout.title: The Garnish Ultimatum
chef_walkout.body: Chef Bảo is holding a plate of coriander like a hostage. 'It goes ON TOP, or I go OUT THE DOOR.'

c.apologise: Apologise to him in front of the kitchen
c.his_way: Concede: the coriander goes on top

r.apologise: He accepts with the grace of a man who has already won.
r.let_go: He leaves. The broth tastes fine. The drama is irreplaceable.
r.his_way: He plates it reverently. Honestly? It does look better.

health_inspection.title: White Gloves
health_inspection.body: Inspector Hạnh arrives unannounced, one finger already extended toward your counter.

c.envelope: Slip an envelope across the counter
c.shine: Stand back. The kitchen already shines.

r.scrub: The finger comes up clean. She almost smiles.
r.envelope: She opens it, photographs it, and files it. That went badly.
r.shine: She checks twice. 'Acceptable.' From her, that's poetry.

investor_pitch_chin.title: Tea With Auntie Chín
investor_pitch_chin.body: She queues like everyone else, eats, wipes her mouth, and says: 'I'd like to buy a piece of your future.'

c.counter: Counter with your reputation on the table
c.decline: Decline with both hands and a bow

r.accept: She signs with a fountain pen older than the building.
r.counter: She raises an eyebrow, then her offer. 'Good. Don't do that to me again.'
r.decline: She nods. 'Patience is also an investment.' The door stays open.

investor_pitch_dan.title: Dollar Dan's Big Idea
investor_pitch_dan.body: 'Picture it: PHO. KING. EVERYWHERE.' Dan slides a term sheet over, sunglasses still on, indoors, at night.

c.negotiate: Let Auntie Chín redline the term sheet

r.take: Champagne appears from nowhere. So does the equity clause.
r.negotiate: Auntie Chín removes four clauses and his sunglasses. Better deal.
r.decline: 'Your loss, chief.' He tips no one on the way out.

rival_undercut.title: Price War on the Corner
rival_undercut.body: Ngà has chalked '25k PHỞ' on her board, directly facing your cart. Her smile is pure declaration of war.

c.peace: Walk over with two bowls and talk

r.price_war: A week of thin margins; the street eats like royalty and remembers you held the line.
r.ignore: Some regulars drift. Phở loyalty is real, but so is a discount.
r.peace: You trade secrets. Her fish sauce trick is genuinely brilliant.

critic_visit.title: The Slurp Is Here
critic_visit.body: Quang sits, closes his eyes, and orders 'whatever the broth wants me to have.' His column runs Sunday.

c.comp: Comp the meal and pile on extras
c.wing_it: Treat him like any other customer

r.best: He listens to the broth for a long time. Sunday's headline has stars in it.
r.comp: He notes the gesture — kindly, and in print, with an asterisk.
r.wing_it: Sunday's column is titled 'A Bowl of Missed Chances'. Ouch.

blogger_feature.title: @PhoEver Wants Content
blogger_feature.body: Mai's camera is already eating. 'One reel. Steam everywhere. You stirring dramatically. Yes?'

c.invite: Lean in — give her the full show

r.invite: The reel does numbers. Tomorrow's queue has matching tote bags.
r.ignore: She posts the cart anyway, caption: 'mysterious'. Could be worse.

cart_breakdown.title: The Wheel Gives Up
cart_breakdown.body: The cart's front wheel sheds a bolt mid-street. Your broth pot sways like a pendulum.

c.diy: Fix it yourself with wire and hope
c.uncle: Call Uncle Tám and his chopsticks

r.diy: It holds. Your back disagrees with your optimism.
r.uncle: He fixes it grumbling the whole time. It steers better than new.
r.parts: Smooth as a new moto. The wallet hurts; the wheel purrs.

pavement_sweep.title: Clear the Pavement!
pavement_sweep.body: Whistles up the street — a pavement sweep is rolling toward your pitch, and Officer Long is at the front of it.

c.fine: Stay put and pay the fine

r.run: You and the cart take the alley at speed. Half the queue follows at a jog.
r.fine: Paperwork, stamped twice. Long writes slowly so you can finish serving.
r.nod: Long inspects the cart very thoroughly from the far side of the street.

grandma_recipe.title: Grandma's Midnight Broth
grandma_recipe.body: Grandma Yến taps your shoulder at closing. 'Tonight I cook. You watch. You do not write, you remember.'

c.listen: Stay up all night and learn it properly
c.later: Promise to learn it next week
c.busy: Too busy — maybe next year, Grandma

r.listen: At 4am it finally makes sense. The secret isn't an ingredient. It's the order. And the patience.
r.later: She nods the nod of a woman who has heard 'next week' before.
r.busy: She says nothing. The silence has a flavour, and it is bitter.

typhoon_day.title: Typhoon Warning
typhoon_day.body: Rain comes in sideways. The street empties — except for three drenched regulars looking at you hopefully.

c.shelter: Open the awning to the whole street, on the house

r.close: Sensible. The cart survives; the regulars forgive, mostly.
r.serve: Hot phở in a typhoon: the stuff of street legend.
r.shelter: Twelve neighbours, one awning, free broth. Nobody forgets it.

festival_rush.title: Festival Weekend
festival_rush.body: Lanterns up, drums out — the festival lands on your street and the whole city is hungry.

c.work: Triple the stock and work the crowd

r.work: You sell out twice. Your ladle hand needs a holiday.
r.skip: You watch the fireworks for once. The competition watches your customers.

supplier_offer.title: First Pick at the Market
supplier_offer.body: Sang pulls back a tarp: bones so fresh they're practically still arguing. 'Exclusive. For partners.'

c.taste: Ask for a sample batch first

r.deal: Handshake, then first pick of every delivery before the market even opens.
r.taste: The sample broth is outrageous. He knows you'll be back.
r.decline: He shrugs. The tarp closes over the good stuff.

karaoke_diplomacy.title: Invitation From Silk
karaoke_diplomacy.body: An invitation in gold ink: Sáu's birthday, her bar, tonight. Attendance is, technically, optional.

c.sing: Get up and sing your heart out
c.rounds: Keep the table's glasses full all night
c.leave: Show face, then slip out early

r.sing: Your rendition is dreadful and Sáu adores it. You're 'family' now, terrifyingly.
r.rounds: Expensive, but by midnight half the district owes you a favour.

michelin_whisper.title: A Reservation For One
michelin_whisper.body: A reservation for one, made under a name nobody recognises, at exactly the quiet hour. The kitchen holds its breath.

c.flawless: Serve like it's the only bowl you'll ever make

r.flawless: The guest eats in silence, pays in cash, and photographs nothing. A good sign. The best sign.
r.panic: The linen confuses the regulars but the bowl lands true.
r.cool: They leave half a smile behind. Impossible to read.

vu_lunch.title: Two-Stroke's Lunch Break
vu_lunch.body: Vũ parks the moto and inhales. 'One bowl, boss. I've got gossip from three districts and an empty stomach.'

r.on_house: He pays in gossip and free advertising shouted at traffic lights.
r.charge: He pays, fair enough — but today's gossip goes to the bánh mì cart.
